summary.intent: Get a status update on the ongoing improvements work, get recommendations on pending decisions, and have the assistant carry out those recommendations, starting with merging the review-slop evaluation branch into the frontend-design-evaluation branch.
summary.outcome: Merged worktree-review-slop-evaluation into worktree-frontend-design-evaluation: resolved 10 conflicts, restored a dropped closing backstory tag in scribe/drift-checker, shortened the explorer description, and ran just check and just claude-validate (both exit 0) before committing the merge locally. Nothing was pushed, and the draft PR and remaining recommendation steps were not started.

repo: Two branches (frontend-design-evaluation and review-slop-evaluation) both built overlapping pieces: transcript-metrics.py, muse exit-gate verdict@3 move, Codex catalog and justfile, so merging produced 10 conflicts.
Agent descriptions have a 450-character routing limit enforced by checks; the explorer description had to be shortened to meet it.
Prompt-weight cuts from the review-slop branch dropped the closing </backstory> tag in plugins/scribe/agents/drift-checker.md, which broke the check until restored.
After conflict resolution, `just marketplace-sync` must run before `just check` because generated dist/ and harness copies (e.g. dist/codex/...) need to be regenerated.
`just check` does not include `just fmt-check`, and `just claude-validate` is a separate step; network-denial messages during claude-validate are CLI telemetry, not validation failures.

Merge resolution strategy used: keep 'ours' for transcript-metrics (covers agents, skills, gates, outputs, context), muse plugin.json/README, Codex catalog and component SKILL; take 'theirs' for plugins/muse/agents/exit-gate.md.
workflow: Prefer a merge over a rebase when two branches have many overlapping conflicts, since conflicts get resolved once instead of per commit.
Use `git merge --no-commit --no-ff` and inspect conflict hunks with awk '/^<<<<<<< /,/^>>>>>>> /' before resolving.
Use `git checkout --ours/--theirs -- <files>` for bulk resolution of files where one side clearly wins, then script the remaining hand-edits in small Python helpers.
Verify merges by running the full check and validate commands plus `git diff --cached --check` before committing.

friction: Merge of the review-slop branch conflicted in 10 files, many from duplicated implementations of the same features.
The resolve.py script had to be run more than once, and the first just check run failed until the drift-checker backstory tag and explorer description length were fixed.
Initial `just check` failure output was silent, requiring a grep over output to find the cause.
The merge was invoked from a non-git primary working directory context, so git commands used absolute /usr/bin/git paths.
open_items: Approve ADR 011 and ADR 012 (ADR 012 only live-tested on muse:exit-gate; run the other four gates live).
Decide on paired-analysis (recommendation was to keep it) and note the review-slop A/B batch approval still owed.
Push the branch as a draft PR after the merge, pending user authorization.
Wave 2 gate hygiene (WP-50–58): deterministic parts first (evidence-citing blockers, wording-only blockers as notes); hold the 'orchestrator owns spawning' change.
Waves 3 to 5: spec@2, render evidence, critic agents, prompt ablations and the AGENTS.md pass.
Context-plan items: outcome-level plans in navigator/planner, moving exploration record shapes out of skill bodies with a re-pilot; measure effect of the context-hygiene rule.
Coverage gaps: live hook runs for scribe, smith, sentinel and ranger; Codex and Antigravity enforcement and install checks; release bookkeeping; run `just fmt-check` which hasn't been run.
Run the paired comparison on one real design task before treating ADR 011 as proven.
